apps.name: Photon
apps.notes: First release: layers & groups, selections (Magic Wand, Quick Selection, lassos), Free Transform, 27 blend modes, adjustment layers, filters, layer styles, PSD open/save and Export Layer As.

apps.name: Prism
apps.notes: First release: a clean Chromium browser with built-in ad & tracker blocking (EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock Origin lists), HTTPS upgrades, third-party cookie blocking, private windows, tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads and no telemetry.

apps.name: Cut
apps.notes: Fixes the video preview freezing during playback while the audio kept going, especially with screen recordings (OBS and similar), and keeps playback moving on a busy PC. The preview now sits on top with the timeline below, the project frame is outlined so its aspect ratio is easy to see, and the preview footer shows the project format (click it to change). New: Match media in Project Properties and Match Project Video Settings in the media bin.

apps.name: Facet
apps.notes: New widgets: Spotify (album art, progress, play/pause, skip, shuffle and repeat; works with the Spotify app, no sign-in), a Control Center (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, night light and dark mode toggles, now playing, time, CPU and memory, brightness and volume sliders, and quick buttons), and Recent folders. Add them with the Widget button in Facet or from the tray.

apps.name: Quartz
apps.notes: Text boxes can be resized: pick a size in the Size list, or select a text box and drag its corner handle. The colour and size controls for text, drawing and highlights now work (they were being ignored), and change the selected annotation when one is selected. A drawing made just before saving is no longer left out.

apps.name: Onyx
apps.notes: Click the Saved notice to see your clip: it has a Show in folder button that opens File Explorer with the clip selected. The notice stays up a little longer, and for as long as the pointer is on it; clicking it doesn't take the focus away from your game.
